summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer exam and build practical skills for planning and implementing an ISMS.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who coordinate or advise on establishing, operating, or maintaining an ISMS against ISO/IEC 27001 requirements.
prerequisites: The main requirement for participating in this training course is general knowledge of ISMS concepts and ISO/IEC 27001.
